content.transcript: Online learning gives students flexibility in location and timing, but effective courses require more than recorded lectures. Clear instructions, opportunities for interaction, timely feedback, and accessible materials all influence learning. The speaker concludes that course design, rather than delivery technology alone, determines whether online education works well.
